title: Headless claude print mode duplicate tool use id 400 is a CLI harness bug not zonoid
summary: Symptom: headless `claude -p` runs (e.g. ARC-AGI-3 Mode 0 bench) fail with HTTP 400 invalid_request_error "messages.1.content.N: `tool_use` ids must be unique". Investigation isolated it to the Claude Code CLI itself, version 2.1.1, NOT zonoid and NOT the bench: (1) reproduced standalone outside the bench; (2) reproduced in the no-zonoid cold arm; (3) reproduced with NO MCP servers at all (--strict-mcp-config --mcp-config '{"mcpServers":{}}'), so the orchestrator-graph MCP is not involved. Mechanism: stream-json shows the model emitting clean sequential tool calls with UNIQUE ids (turn1 Bash, turn2 Read), yet the follow-up request still 400s on messages.1 (the FIRST assistant turn) having duplicate tool_use ids — so the CLI mis-assembles the wire-format assistant message with colliding tool_use ids. The error always lands on messages.1, varying content index by how many tool blocks the first turn made. WORKAROUND confirmed: a prompt that uses no tools (e.g. --disallowedTools Bash Read Glob Grep Edit Write WebFetch WebSearch Task TodoWrite) completes cleanly. REAL FIX: installed CLI is 2.1.1 but npm latest is 2.1.195 — upgrade @anthropic-ai/claude-code; the bug is almost certainly fixed upstream. Not fixable from this repo.
